name: spawn_agent
description: Spawn a background agent for an independent subtask.

collect.description: Block and wait for result (not recommended)

name: agent_status
description: Check status of all running agents.

name: kill_agent
description: Cancel a running agent by ID.

name: teacher_guidance
description: Respond to a subagent's teacher escalation request with mentorship guidance and optional plan corrections. Only use when you receive a [TEACHER ESCALATION REQUEST] message.

agent_id.description: The agent ID from the escalation request

guidance.description: Specific actionable instructions for what the agent is doing wrong and how to fix it

todo_updates.description: Optional JSON array of plan corrections. Actions: add, remove, replace, skip. Example: [{"action": "add", "content": "new step"}]
